description: This file defines a Go interface and implementation for interacting with a build API, including functions for retrieving build IDs, downloading artifacts, and handling API errors. It serves as a client library for build-related operations within a larger system.

classes.name: BuildAPIError
classes.description: Custom error type for handling build API errors, includes message and error code.

classes.name: AndroidCIBuildAPI
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the BuildAPI interface for interacting with the Android CI build system's API, including methods for fetching build IDs and downloading artifacts.

methods.name: GetLatestGreenBuildID
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent successful build ID for a specified branch and target.

methods.name: DownloadArtifact
methods.description: Downloads a specific artifact associated with a build by name, build ID, and target.

methods.name: getSignedURL
methods.description: Generates a signed URL to securely download an artifact.

methods.name: doGETToWriter
methods.description: Performs a GET request to a URL and writes the response directly to an io.Writer.

methods.name: doGETToJSON
methods.description: Performs a GET request to a URL and decodes the JSON response into the provided object.

methods.name: doGETCommon
methods.description: Common internal method to perform an HTTP GET request, with optional authorization headers.

methods.name: parseErrorResponse
methods.description: Parses an error response body from the server into a BuildAPIError.

methods.name: BuildDownloadArtifactSignedURL
methods.description: Constructs a signed URL for artifact download based on build ID, target, and artifact name.
